title: feat(ui): bring the remaining shared UI changes from website v2
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Brings the remaining `packages/ui` changes from #14472 (website v2) to main, so the site PRs only touch `pollinations.ai/`. Earlier UI extractions: #14843, #14855. The SDK audio methods moved to #15917.

- **Colour mode:** choosing the mode the system already uses now clears the stored choice, so later visits follow the system again. Before, one click pinned the mode forever. No live system listener.
- **Connect button:** `AppUserMenu` gets `connectSize="lg"` for the v2 Play page, as one md/lg size table. The default is unchanged.
- **Enter:** removes the unused Pixelify Sans Google Fonts link. `font-pixel` is the self-hosted Geist Pixel Square.
- **CI:** runs the `@pollinations/ui` tests next to the SDK tests.

Enter looks the same; only the toggle's saved choice changes.

Tests:
- `@pollinations/ui` 90 passed (also without an SDK build, as in CI)
- Enter typecheck; Enter `build:frontend`
- Local Enter: click to the non-system mode → stored; click back → cleared; reload under the other system mode follows it; no Google Fonts request

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: A toggle that lets go
gist.blurb: The colour toggle now knows when to let the system decide again. One less preference to manage forever.
gist.summary: The shared UI colour toggle now clears its saved choice when you select the current system mode, while AppUserMenu gains an optional large Connect button for the v2 Play page.
gist.impact: After switching back to the system’s current mode, your next visit follows the system preference; the Connect button keeps its existing size unless the new option is used.
gist.visual_concept: Polli helps a small retro computer hand control of a sun-and-moon colour toggle back to a system-settings dial. A larger Connect button sits nearby as a secondary detail, with code-plants around the desk; the mood is a small, satisfying UI fix rather than a site redesign.
